title: Orientation of an IM representation along a bi-Lipschitz parametrised piece: J_G·ξ∘G = s·(DG e) with a Borel sign s (Simon 6.3.4–3.5; step 3, (B2′), of the selected proof)
statement: Let N, k ∈ ℕ and let R = (M, θ, ξ) be an IMRep of degree k in univ ⊆ ℝ^N with Hᵏ(M) < ∞ (Hᵏ = μHE[k]). Let G : ℝᵏ → ℝ^N be L-Lipschitz, B ⊆ ℝᵏ Borel and κ > 0 with κ|a − a'| ≤ |G(a) − G(a')| for a, a' ∈ B, G differentiable with injective derivative at every point of B, and G(B) ⊆ M. Then there is a Borel function s : ℝᵏ → ℝ with s(u) ∈ {1, −1} for every u such that, for Lebesgue-a.e. u ∈ B and every k-covector α on ℝ^N, J_G(u)·ξ(G(u))(α) = s(u)·α(DG(u)e_0, …, DG(u)e_{k−1}), where e_a := EuclideanSpace.single a 1 and J_G(u) := (det[⟨DG(u)e_a, DG(u)e_b⟩]_{a,b})^{1/2}.
lean_statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid N)) k) (G : Euclid k → Euclid N) (B : Set (Euclid k)) (L : NNReal) (κ : ℝ), μHE[k] R.carrier ≠ ∞ → LipschitzWith L G → MeasurableSet B → 0 < κ → (∀ a ∈ B, ∀ a' ∈ B, κ * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → (∀ a ∈ B, DifferentiableAt ℝ G a ∧ Injective (fderiv ℝ G a)) → G '' B ⊆ R.carrier → ∃ s : Euclid k → ℝ, Measurable s ∧ (∀ u, s u = 1 ∨ s u = -1) ∧ ∀ᵐ u ∂(volume.restrict B), ∀ α : Covector (Euclid N) k, Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin k => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))) * R.orient (G u) α = s u * α (fun a => fderiv ℝ G u (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ)))
